_: Schema example. A real bible/style.json is git-ignored personalisation.
idiom: One illustration language, named and described in a sentence or two. This is the first thing in every assembled prompt and the standard the vision gate judges against.

palette._: every colour the world may use, named by role, as hex - measured against by palette-conform

texture: how surfaces are finished (grain, flat, wash)

gates._: optional per-gate threshold overrides, keyed by gate id; anything absent takes the engine default
